# Link

An underlined link with a visible focus ring, distinct hover and visited colours, and a safe external variant.

```tsx
import { Link } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- To go to another page, section or file.

## When not to

- To run an action on the page: use a Button.
- `external` as a default: opening a new tab takes control from the reader. Use it only when leaving would lose their work.
- Text such as "aquí" or "ver más".

## Examples

### In a sentence

Links are underlined, so colour is never the only signal.

```tsx
<p className="kafka-type-reading-body max-w-prose">
  Lee las <Link href="#bases">bases del concurso</Link> antes de enviar tu relato, y consulta el <Link href="https://example.com" external>reglamento completo</Link>.
</p>
```

### On its own line

A standalone link is at least 44 px tall.

```tsx
<Link href="#programa" variant="standalone">Ver el programa 2026</Link>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `href` (required) | `string` |  |  |
| `external` | `boolean` | `false` | Opens in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, shows an icon and tells screen readers. Use it only when leaving would lose the reader's work. |
| `variant` | `'inline' \| 'standalone'` | `'inline'` | `inline` sits in a sentence; `standalone` is a link on its own line, at least 44 px tall. |
| …rest | `AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Never colour alone:** links are always underlined.
- **Contrast:** default, hover and visited colours are each checked against page and surface, in both modes.
- **External:** `target="_blank"` with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, an icon, and visually hidden text "(se abre en una pestaña nueva)".
- **Target:** `standalone` links are at least 44 px tall; inline links follow the exception for links inside a sentence.

## Content

- The link text says where it goes: "bases del concurso".
